question: How many years passed between the year the city became the capital of the Volga German republic and the year it became part of Saratov Oblast after that republic was disestablished?
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là hiệu số năm giữa hai mốc location đã nêu tên, cả hai đều chỉ có năm.
criterion: Two named location milestones: the city becoming capital of the Volga German ASSR, and the city becoming part of Saratov Oblast after the ASSR was disestablished.
